t: Arrival In Shanghai Of Russian General Bourlin

pages.en:
1.0. 6980    A.R. 7-3
Shanghai Municipal Police
Intelligence Office    Station.
August    7    1926
REPORT ON    Arrival in Shanghai of Russian General Bourlin.
Made by Tem.Clerical Asst. Cook    Forwarded by
Sir,
Investigations show that General Bourlin whose arrival in Shanghai was announced in the local Russian newspaper "Zaria", is the representative of the Grand Duke Nikolai Nikolaiovitch. He arrived here from Hankow and as he possesses considerable influence with the local Cossack groups, the object of his visit is to smooth over the present trouble existing among these Cossack groups.
As a result of his endeavours, a meeting was held on ~~July~~ August 5 at 721 Avenue Foch where a formal committee was elected that is expected to bring about the unification of the various Cossack groups, hitherto separated. It is further ascertained that General Bourlin who is an Orenburg Cossack is not friendly disposed towards Mr. Shendrikoff, but favours Mr. Grosse.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
John Cook.
Tem.Clerical Asst.
D. C. I.

1926年8月7日
关于俄国将军布尔林（Bourlin）抵沪的报告。
由临时文书助理库克（Cook）呈报    转呈
阁下，
经查，当地俄文报纸《曙光报》（Zaria）曾刊登俄国将军布尔林抵沪的消息，该将军系尼古拉·尼古拉耶维奇大公的代表。他从汉口抵达此处，鉴于他在本地哥萨克群体中拥有相当影响力，其来访目的在于调和目前这些哥萨克群体之间存在的纠纷。
经过他的努力，于~~7月~~8月5日在福煦路721号举行了一次会议，会上选举产生了一个正式委员会，预期该委员会将促成迄今处于分裂状态的各哥萨克群体的统一。另查明，布尔林将军系奥伦堡哥萨克人，他对申德里科夫先生（Mr. Shendrikoff）持不友好态度，而支持格罗斯先生（Mr. Grosse）。
此致，
阁下之恭顺仆人，
约翰·库克。
临时文书助理
副督察长
